a0d7c4f5:  .;
 .;This routine is used to generate a deficiency report for the
 .;Provider's Deficiency Tracking module. It allows the user to
 .;select specific parameters for the report.
e0e695b7: ;If user chose to divide report into multiple parts, call the division routine.
6a569145: ;If user did not choose to divide report, set deficiency tracking division.
14dee6d6: ;Call routine for user to select which type of report (physician, service or patient).
a2229520: ;Call routine to set date range for report.
f491aeee: ;Initialize variables and call FileMan utility to get deficiency types.
b482214a: ;Ask user additional questions about report parameters.
59185a38: ;Inform user that the report requires 132 column output.
d75e20aa: ;Get current date and convert to external format for report header.
a3367fcd: ;Set variables, call utility to handle device selection, and go to report compilation.
b873b918: ;Exit point.
b4043d24: ;Loop through all records, check selection criteria, and build temp global for report.
290ba0f9: ;If report type is physician summary or division summary, go to respective routine.
5c72aca2: ;If report type is service/specialty summary, go to respective routine.
cbc61bb6: ;If no records meet selection criteria, display message.
43c20438: ;Quit and return to calling routine.

31da0e83:  ;
 ;Check patient selection from the PATIENT SELECTION menu (PAS).
 ;PAS passes DGJTMUL and DGJTL as follows:
 ; If DGJTMUL = 0, only one patient was selected and DGJTL doesn't matter.
 ; If DGJTMUL = 1, multiple patients were selected, and
 ;  DGJTL = 'PAT' for patient list,
 ;  DGJTL = 'PHY' for physician list,
 ;  DGJTL = 'SER' for service list.
58349935: ;Get the case-team number from the Institution file.
c7b3bedb: ;Get the Case-Team Number from the Attend Staff File.
1c1d35b4: ;Get the Ward from the Attend Staff File.
ea992790: ;Get the Division from the Ward File entry.
b08e3e20: ;Get the Division from the Institution File.
db7b8c3d: ;Get the Service Name from the Service File.
8a9920f2: ;If the Service Name is not specified, get the first entry in the Service File.
e870a2be: ;Get the Specialty Name from the Specialty File.
7120bf4a: ;Return.
ab1e46ba: ;Skip entry if it does not match the selected division or is not a division that was selected.
3b4276b3: ;Skip entry if it does not match the selected division.
6cbd2e5b: ;Skip entry if it is marked as 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' and the review date is null.
c8af8d7c: ;Skip entry if it is marked as 'REVIEWED' and the review date is not null.
c3d11362: ;Quit if the review status is Completed.
f103b66b: ;Clean up variables.
4fa95cc0: ;Quit if service required and not specified.
c5945b5a: ;Quit if service not required and is specified.
16eb8d53: ;Quit if deficiency type specified and not selected.
d1c90f6a: ;Quit if date is outside the begin and end date range.
fe374bad: ;Quit if physician required and not selected.
71900f58: ;Quit if patient required and not selected.
5e27c8ac: ;Quit if this is a summary record for a discrepancy.
7925b223: ;Get division name and count division totals.
445a7f97: ;Get patient name and set TMP global subscript.
14e1f7d3: ;Set TMP global for physician sort.
51f45ebc: ;Set TMP global for patient sort.
37c41a38: ;Get service and specialty descriptions.
c6f684ec: ;Set service description and check if selected.
6a543a6e: ;If printing by Specialty and Service, pull the names.
6816afd1: ;If the record didn't pass the screening criteria, quit.
76819843: ;Store the record in ^TMP for Service, Specialty, Patient and entry number.
